zh: 多方面的；要从多方面考虑的
en: having many different aspects to be considered
ex: a complex and multifaceted problem
一个复杂的需从多方面考虑的问题

zh: 多种的；各种各样的；多样的
en: of many different kinds; having great variety
ex: the multifarious life forms in the coral reef
珊瑚礁上的多种生命形式

zh: 多功能的；起多种作用的
en: having several different functions
ex: a multifunctional device
多功能装置

zh: a type of oil that can be used in many different engines
en: a type of oil that can be used in many different engines
containing several different types of grain
ex: multigrain bread
杂粮面包

en: a piece of equipment that can be used to exercise different parts of the body

zh: 有多条边的；有多个部分的
en: in which three or more groups, nations, etc. take part
ex: multilateral negotiations
多边谈判

zh: 多边主义，多边政策（为达成核裁军多边协议）
en: the policy of trying to make multilateral agreements in order to achieve nuclear disarmament

zh: 用多种语言书写（或印刷）的
en: speaking or using several different languages
ex: multilingual translators/communities/societies
多语翻译者／社群／社会

en: the use of sound, pictures and film in addition to text on a screen
ex: mobile multimedia
移动多媒体

zh: 拥有数百万资产的富翁；千万富翁
en: a person who has money and possessions worth several million pounds, dollars, etc.
existing in or involving many countries
ex: multinational companies/corporations
跨国公司

zh: a package containing a number of products that are similar or the same, often costing less than the cost of buying each item separately
en: a package containing a number of products that are similar or the same, often costing less than the cost of buying each item separately
ex: The ice creams are sold either individually or in multipacks of four.
冰淇淋既可以单独出售，也可以四个装出售。

zh: 多党派的；涉及多党派的
en: involving several different political parties
ex: These are the country’s first multiparty elections.
这是该国第一次多党选举。

zh: （电脑游戏）多人模式的（支持多个玩家同时玩）
en: used to describe a computer game that can be played by more than one person at the same time
ex: The game will support up to four players in multiplayer mode.
这款游戏在多人模式下最多支持四名玩家。

zh: complex in its nature or effects; affecting several parts of the body
en: many in number; involving many different people or things
ex: The shape appears multiple times within each painting.
形状在每幅画中出现多次。

en: a rare condition in which a person seems to have one or more different personalities
a disease of the nervous system that gets worse over a period of time with loss of feeling in the body and loss of control of movement and speech
